Objective: To enable the bank to transition from SWIFT MT messages to ISO 20022

compliance, standardized messaging, enhanced data quality, and uninterrupted
payment processing.

Defined and validated SWIFT MT to ISO 20022 (MX) message mapping (e.g.,

Gathered and documented business requirements for SEPA payment processing,
